editorVerdict: Ash King's album launch is the editorial hook here. Country day format with full lineup from midday means it's worth building the Sunday around.
editorNote:
Tar Barrel in Mornington is running a Country Day on Sunday August 2. Ash King plays his album launch from 12pm to 3pm, then Hand Over Hammer take over from 4pm to 7pm. Country drink specials and Sunday Sippers happy hour run through the day.

Good Sunday format - arrive at noon, eat, drink, catch both sets, open till late if you're still going. Check the Tar Barrel website for entry details before you go.
